title: A Swarm of Nano Quadrotors
summary: A short demo from the GRASP Lab at the University of Pennsylvania showing a swarm of nano quadrotors flying in coordinated formations. The vehicles were developed by KMel Robotics.
why: HN refers to it as the viral university video that showed what autonomous multicopter swarms can do and helped spark interest in multicopters.

quote.text: a university experiment video that went viral
